title.en: Confirm 45 kW Before You Order Electric 40 from Xingtai
title.zh: 向邢台订电动40之前先确认 45 kW

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Electric 40 at 45 kW, 21 m³/h and 23 MPa, with two distance rows. The site must be able to feed 45 kW. The mixer’s 45 kW main motor is a different machine.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动40印成 45 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa，并有两行距离。现场必须能供给 45 kW。搅拌泵的 45 kW 主电机是另一台机器。

h1.en: The Electric 40 Purchase Hinges on 45 kW
h1.zh: 电动40的采购取决于 45 kW

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Electric 40 as a 45 kW motor, output 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, fine-stone 120 m / 360 m, aggregate-13 40 m / 120 m, Kawasaki 112, frame 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm and 2300 kg. Order it when the site can feed 45 kW and you can name which distance row you mean. The electric mixer also prints a 45 kW main motor, but it adds a 14 kW mixer motor and a single 100 m / 300 m pair. Do not buy the mixer by copying only 45 kW. No price is printed.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）把电动40印成电机 45 kW、输送量 21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、细石 120 m / 360 m、13 骨料 40 m / 120 m、川崎 112、外形 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm、2300 kg。现场能供给 45 kW，并且你能点明距离行时，才订它。电动搅拌泵也印主电机 45 kW，但另外有搅拌电机 14 kW 和一组 100 m / 300 m。不要只抄 45 kW 去买搅拌泵。没有印价格。

body.en: Fine stone is 120 m / 360 m. Aggregate 13 is 40 m / 120 m. One number without the label is incomplete.
body.zh: 细石是 120 m / 360 m。13 骨料是 40 m / 120 m。没有标题的一个数字是不完整的。

body.en: Electric Low Pressure 40 is 37 kW and 12–15 m³/h. Saying “low pressure 40” changes the order.
body.zh: 电动低压40是 37 kW、12–15 m³/h。说“低压40”会改变订单。

body.en: 45 kW, the row, stone size, and [/en/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/](/en/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/) to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/).
body.zh: 45 kW、行名、石子粒径，以及 [/zh/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/](/zh/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/) ，发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。

answer.en: No. Send site voltage and frequency.
answer.zh: 没有。请发送现场电压和频率。

alt.zh: 电动40型混凝土泵，由河北品锦机械厂家制造，邢台
